When you’re a natural athlete, you don’t have to think about “how”
you perform — your ability moves you forward to meet every challenge
with ease. The Selec-Terrain® Traction Management system, with the class-
exclusive11 Selec-Terrain dial, is included on every Cherokee equipped with
4WD, handing over the natural ability to tackle the toughest conditions
out there. Choose from up to five modes: Auto, Sport, Snow, Sand/Mud
and available Rock. When you’re competing with winter’s formidable
conditions, go for the Cold Weather Group, a team of bundled features
that give you real advantages including heated mirrors, steering wheel
and front seats, plus remote start and windshield wiper de-icer.

C A P A B I L I T Y A N D S T Y L E .
Cherokee Limited commands attention and the road. It features
an elegant Chrome-surrounded seven-slot grille with active grille shutters, fog lamps, automatic High Intensity
Discharge (HID) headlamps and LED daytime running lamps (DRLs). Body-color power, manual foldaway mirrors with
heating elements, courtesy lamps and supplemental turn signals add style matched with function to Limited’s signature
appearance. Bright roof rails are a crowning feature that prove useful for bringing more along on adventurous travels.
Limited’s interior puts standard luxury features at hand, such as leather-trimmed seats, a heated leather-wrapped
steering wheel and a best-in-class11 8.4-inch full-color touchscreen radio.
S O U N D T E C H N O L O G Y.
You’ll be moved by the music quality
emanating from the available premium Alpine® nine-speaker sound system with its 8-inch
subwoofer, and informed by the vehicle alerts and performance data presented on the
available 7-inch Multi-View Display Cluster. The available Uconnect® 8.4 NAV radio
offers 3-dimensional navigational maps and travel data on an impressive, full-color
best-in-class11 8.4-inch touchscreen. Uconnect is an award-winning system offering a full
menu of intuitive apps and entertainment services, including SiriusXM® Satellite Radio6
and Integrated Voice Command3 with Bluetooth,® and can even connect your vehicle to
available Wi-Fi13 and to your smartphone.
